# The package a sql: import writes for PostgreSQL, run against the harness's
# server (internal/testsql) on the interpreter and each Go platform; android
# reaches SQLite alone. Each test opens a database of its own, which
# `sqlserver` empties before every target's run. A launch answered from its
# record reaches no server, so CI, which has none, replays those alone.

[postgresql] sqlserver postgresql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
[postgresql] sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
[postgresql] stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[postgresql] sqlserver postgresql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[postgresql] sqlserver postgresql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[postgresql] sqlserver postgresql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// Every PostgreSQL type the import reads written and read back, a numeric
// read through the cast its note asks for, a failure
// classified by its SQLSTATE, and RETURNING read as a query's one value.

import async "sngl:async"
import books "sql:./db/queries.sql"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const server = "postgres://sngl@127.0.0.1:47830/"

func add(title string, shelf books.Shelf = books.Shelf.fiction) int64 {
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title=title, pages=null, rating=0.0, lent=false, shelf=shelf, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { return id.or(-1) }
        failed { return -1 }
    }
}

func testRoundTrip(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "roundtrip?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Earthsea", pages=264, rating=4.5, lent=true, shelf=books.Shelf.nonFiction, added="2024-03-01T10:30:00Z", due="2024-04-01") {
        ok { t.assert(id == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(id.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=1) {
        ok {
            if b == null {
                t.assert(false)
            } else {
                t.assert(b.title == "Earthsea")
                t.assert(b.pages == 264)
                t.assert(b.price == "0.00")
                t.assert(b.rating == 4.5)
                t.assert(b.lent)
                t.assert(b.shelf == books.Shelf.nonFiction)
                t.assert(b.added != null && "{b.added}" == "2024-03-01T10:30:00Z")
                t.assert(b.due != null && "{b.due}" == "2024-04-01")
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNulls(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "nulls?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok {
            if b == null {
                t.assert(false)
            } else {
                t.assert(b.pages == null)
                t.assert(b.added == null)
                t.assert(b.due == null)
                t.assert(!b.lent)
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testMissing(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "missing?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=99) {
        ok { t.assert(b == null) }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testMany(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "many?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    add("The Farthest Shore")
    add("A Wizard of Earthsea", books.Shelf.poetry)
    add("Tales", books.Shelf.poetry)
    match var found = books.onShelfCall(shelf=books.Shelf.poetry) {
        ok {
            t.assert(found.length() == 2)
            t.assert(found[0].title == "A Wizard of Earthsea")
        }
        failed { t.assert(found.message == "") }
    }
    match var n = books.countBooksCall() {
        ok { t.assert(n == 3) }
        failed { t.assert(n.message == "") }
    }
}

func testExec(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "exec?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    t.assert(books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=id).ok == 1)
    t.assert(books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=99).ok == 0)
    match var done = books.removeBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(done.rows == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(done.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(b == null) }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

// A unique violation is SQLSTATE 23505, which a retry fails alike.
func testConstraint(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "constraint?sslmode=disable")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 2)
    add("Tehanu")
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Tehanu", pages=null, rating=0.0, lent=false, shelf=books.Shelf.fiction, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(id.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(id.code == "23505")
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="books")
}
-- db/schema.sql --
-- sngl:engine postgresql

CREATE TYPE shelf AS ENUM ('fiction', 'non-fiction', 'poetry');

CREATE TABLE books (
  id     bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  title  text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pages  integer,
  price  numeric(8, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rating double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lent   boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  shelf  shelf NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fiction',
  added  timestamptz,
  due    date
);
-- db/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema schema.sql

-- name: AddBook :one
INSERT INTO books (title, pages, rating, lent, shelf, added, due)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
RETURNING id;

-- name: GetBook :one
SELECT id, title, pages, price::text AS price, rating, lent, shelf, added, due
FROM books WHERE id = $1;

-- name: OnShelf :many
SELECT id, title FROM books WHERE shelf = $1 ORDER BY id;

-- name: CountBooks :one
SELECT count(*) FROM books;

-- name: LendBook :execrows
UPDATE books SET lent = $1 WHERE id = $2;

-- name: RemoveBook :exec
DELETE FROM books WHERE id = $1;
